_comment: Example only. Merge into the project's package.json; replace every <placeholder>; keep existing project scripts/overrides and remove <existing-postinstall> and its && only if the project has none; <rel-prefix> is ../ (unscoped) or ../../ (scoped). See docs/native-build-preflight.md.
